title: Casas-Alvero Conjecture
exact_target: If a characteristic-zero polynomial has a nonconstant common factor with each derivative below its degree, must all its roots coincide, up to its leading scalar?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1447 (ALG-002). CC BY 4.0.
Soham Ghosh, Proof of the Casas-Alvero Conjecture, arXiv:2501.09272v2 (2026), Section 1.1, Conjecture CA, and the characteristic-zero ordinary-derivative convention.
